thread:
jin: rolled int4-v2 (hybrid) to 5% in us-east as canary — seeing small degrade on longcontext outputs vs baseline. please triage.
maria: noted. which metric spiked? longdoc MRR or factuality?
alex: longdoc_mrr is down ~2.8% over last 2h, but latency looks fine. sample sizes small.
sam: saw similar on a slice of legal docs — hallucination rate up on nested lists. pulling sample bundle.
qa-bot: automated smoke run: `rundiff --baseline v2.1 --candidate int4-v2 --slices longdoc,legal` -> mrr -2.8%, rouge -0.4, hallucination +1.2%
ethan: KV cache warmup looks off in logs: `kv_warmup.misses` increased 6x for longctx requests.
infra-bot: routed 5% traffic to us-west replica as sanity parallel. no errors.
maria: could this be sequence-length sensitivity from quantization? int4 sometimes biased on long context.
alex: agree. can we shadow-compare int8 and int4 for same slice? run `shadow: int8,int4` for 12h and collect concordance.
jin: plan proposal: 1) Pause promotion. 2) Enable auto-fallback if mrr drop >= 3% over 30m window. 3) Ramp shadow int8 at 5% and drain kv cache to simulate warm start. 4) Run targeted eval corpus (2000 longdocs).
sam: +1. also add a hysteresis: require sustained drop 30m + backtest 2h to avoid flapping.
ethan: I'll add config: `promote_policy.auto_fallback.threshold=0.03` and `promote_policy.hysteresis=2h`.
qa-bot: kicked off targeted eval job id `eval-1754329999-ld`. ETA ~45m.
deploy-bot: canary traffic paused (manual) by @jin at request.
jin: thanks. if eval passes (<1% drift) we'll re-run 5% with int8 bridge and monitor concordance. otherwise rollback to v2.1 and run root-cause postmortem.
alex: put sample diff + top 20 failure prompts in #eng-ml later for model team.
maria: noted. I'll start a small test to tune quantization scales if bias shows up.
jin: ping @everyone: keep an eye on `longdoc_mrr` and `kv_warmup.miss_rate` dashboards. :eyes:
